episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a marathon broadcast covering Trump's Board of Peace, Epstein file chaos (including Crumb Bay revelation), and a ski-jumper penis-injection scandal that summons Chet's Science Eyes desk. Munch and Crum derail into a graphic hand-game masterclass, Peter Gibbon unveils a gargoyle-plane conspiracy from the Denver Airport, and AI Rooney glitches through 15 foot-obsessed complaints. The night closes with Kendelle's brief hotel check-in and Brandon's mother-haunted Pokemon Fire Red run that somehow conquers the first gym.
